results.fact: Scramble difficulty and need for a rope
results.correct_value: Class 2-3 scramble; no rope needed (partner requirements should say Class 2-3, no low-5th moves)
results.evidence: The peak's standard route page describes the route as nothing harder than Class 2 unless you choose Class 3 rock to avoid loose scree. A 2024 trip report calls the scree gully the crux with some class 3 moves; the club route page and encyclopedia entry describe it as a scramble with solid rock and some exposure. No source mentions 4th class, 5th class, or roping.

results.correct_value: summitTimeHrs unknown (null); the 7.5 is the car-to-car total
results.evidence: The club route page gives about two hours car to Kangaroo Pass and about one hour pass to summit (~3 hr to the top); a trip report gives a 4-5 hr round trip. The row's approach, partner requirements and itinerary legs all put the summit well before the 7.5 hr total, so summitTimeHrs holds the car-to-car total; nulled rather than replaced with a computed number.

results.fact: Parking pass at the hairpin turnout
results.evidence: One route page for the neighbouring tower says no permits are required to park at the hairpin turn, but the hiking association's page for this peak lists a Northwest Forest Pass / America the Beautiful pass as the parking requirement. Sources disagree; no patch.

results.fact: Reliability of the tarn below Kangaroo Pass
results.correct_value: The tarn below the pass is the only water on the approach but it can be dry by late summer/fall; carry water from the car.
results.evidence: An October 2024 trip report found the tarn below the pass dry and no other water on the path. A separate trip report on the same approach found the tarn near the meadow dried up, with only a trickle below the pass. Calling it 'reliable' is wrong; bivy entry not touched.

results.fact: Itinerary summit clock time vs its own leg durations
results.evidence: From a 6:00 AM start the itinerary's own legs (+1.5-2, +1, +1-1.5 hr) sum to 3.5-4.5 hr, i.e. a summit around 9:30-10:30 AM, not 11:30 AM-12:30 PM. The approach text (2 hr + 1 hr) agrees, and the club route page gives about two hours to the pass and one hour to the summit.
